name: NeuralEditor
definition: A method employing a point cloud-guided NeRF model for shape manipulation, leveraging K-D trees and deterministic integration strategy for accurate point cloud-based rendering, with Phong reflection modeling to enhance color fidelity and geometric detail.
summary: NeuralEditor edits neural radiance fields by intrinsically integrating point clouds, allowing users to manipulate scene geometry by moving points without retraining.
